title: PCR-No_more_Amadron
description: Gets rid of PneumaticCraft: Repressurized's Amadron and adds recipes for the Assembly Programs
body:
This Datapack's main use is to get rid of the Amadron from PCR; This is done by just getting rid of the recipe. 

To keep the mod playable, I added recipes for everything that you can only get from the Amadron. ie - Both of the Assembly Programs

~NOTE~ The PCB blueprint can now only be found as a villager trade.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This Datapack currently only works for 1.20 and 1.20.1,

If you need a different version feel free to go into the code to change 1 number. How to do that (look for "Data pack formats")

NOTE: LINKED WEBSITE IS NOT MINE!!!
